Services

Pick your next style

Six signature services, one standard: neat, comfortable and made to last. Tap “Book this style” and it will be filled in on the booking form for you. A deposit is required to secure every appointment.

Smedium Knotless Braids

The go-to protective style — small-to-medium knotless braids that start flat at the root for a natural look and a comfortable, tension-free feel.

Boho Braids

Braids with soft, loose curls woven through for that effortless, free-flowing boho finish — pretty, light and full of movement.

Feed-Ins

Feed-in braids built up gradually for a seamless, natural hairline and a sleek, polished result from front to back.

Locs

Loc care and styling with the same attention to detail — neat, healthy-looking and styled to suit you.

Men's Braids

Clean parts, sharp lines. Men's braids done properly — neat cornrows and braided styles with a crisp, fresh finish.

Twists

Full, glossy twists with beautiful definition — a versatile protective style that works worn down or pulled up.

Questions

Before you book

Do I need a deposit?

Yes — deposits are required. Your appointment is secured once your deposit has been paid. Troi will confirm the details when you book.

How do I book an appointment?

Call or text 407-819-9335, email tressesbytroi@gmail.com, or send the booking form on this page.

When is Troi available?

Appointments run 9 AM – 11 PM on Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays. Tresses by Troi is closed on Sundays and Thursdays.

Where is Tresses by Troi?

Tresses by Troi is based in Orlando, Florida. Call 407-819-9335 for appointment details, and follow @_tressesbytroi on Instagram to see the latest work.

Which styles can I get?

Smedium knotless braids, boho braids, feed-ins, locs, men's braids and twists — all by Troi, a stylist with 10+ years of experience.
